verdict.rationale: Bento's FAQ says alert rules compile to trace queries and can route to a webhook alongside Slack, PagerDuty and email, so webhook delivery exists for alert and incident events. That is a single FAQ line, and it covers only alert routing, not general event subscription. missing for 10: general-purpose webhook subscriptions for other event types (issues, signal firings, runs), documented payload schemas, delivery guarantees such as retries and signing, setup docs or an API for managing webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
